description: Per-page QA route manifest. Derived from docs/SPEC.md. Each route's expectations are the acceptance criteria the visual-QA agent verifies against the rendered preview.
specSource: docs/SPEC.md and docs/specs/*.md (each route names its spec in specRef)

expectations.desc: What needs the person is the lead: a headline and cards, or a clear "nothing needs you" state
expectations.specClaim: Home answers one question: what needs me

expectations.desc: A waiting question shows its answer options on the card, with the question text and no context-free card
A waiting item appears once; Home does not restate it in a second list
expectations.specClaim: Home MUST NOT restate an item the waiting queue already lists

expectations.desc: Merged work is counted once, with one number, not two competing totals
expectations.specClaim: Progress headline is the one count of delivery

expectations.desc: Renders with no error text or broken layout at the viewport width
Missions are grouped by state (active, waiting, done) with a heading per group
Each mission row shows its title, state and progress in words
expectations.specClaim: Each mission answers what state it is in

expectations.desc: A way to start a new mission is present
No Release now button on the list
expectations.specClaim: Release trigger action MUST NOT appear on the portfolio (§10.2)

expectations.desc: Renders with no error text or broken layout, or shows a plain empty state

routes.title: Mission page

expectations.desc: The mission goal and its current state are at the top in plain words
expectations.specClaim: Mission page answers what state the mission is in

expectations.desc: Work is laid out by stage (Build, Verify, Deliver) with named task rows that open the task page
expectations.specClaim: Build stage lists named rows that open the task page

expectations.desc: Phases show headers and tasks show a kind glyph
expectations.specClaim: Phase and work kind are stored facts shown on every surface

expectations.desc: Shipped/merged work is counted once in the header
Renders with no error text or horizontal overflow

routes.paramHint: Use any existing mission ID (QA_MISSION_ID / mission_id). Skip if no missions exist.

expectations.desc: Tasks are listed with title, status in words and when it last changed, or a plain empty state
expectations.specClaim: Activity lists all tasks across workspaces

expectations.desc: A completed task is never labelled Assigned or Running
expectations.specClaim: Status badge reflects the task state machine

expectations.desc: Each row links to its task page
Renders with no error text or broken layout

routes.title: Task page

expectations.desc: The status badge reads the real state; a completed task MUST NOT read Assigned
A stopped task shows one Build/Verify/Deliver timeline; a running task leads with the live run
expectations.specClaim: The task page leads with the live run while running, one timeline when stopped

expectations.desc: A waiting question shows its answer options and its brief
expectations.specClaim: An open question is one card on every surface

expectations.desc: Run and Details sections hold execution material, spec, dependencies and attempts
expectations.specClaim: Run holds execution material, Details holds spec, dependencies, attempts and time

expectations.desc: Renders with no error text or horizontal overflow

routes.paramHint: Use a recently-completed task (QA_TASK_ID / task_id). The status badge MUST NOT read 'Assigned' for a completed task.

expectations.desc: The Health sub-nav lists Overview, Failures, Runners & capacity, Estimates and Usage
expectations.specClaim: Every /app/health/* page shares the Health sub-nav

expectations.desc: An overview summary of the fleet and recent failures is shown in words with numbers
Any time-window control states the window it covers
Renders with no error text or broken layout
Each runner shows lanes of its runs as a timeline, or a plain empty state when no runners exist
Only runs actually going are open-ended; finished runs end at their end
expectations.specClaim: Only runs going are drawn as open-ended

expectations.desc: A run that has a question is marked as having one, not as running
expectations.specClaim: A parked question is a wait, not a running agent

expectations.desc: Capacity or free slots per runner are stated
Renders with no error text or horizontal overflow
Specs are listed as a tree grouped by area, with Unfiled for the rest
expectations.specClaim: The list shows specs as a tree

expectations.desc: Each row says in words its title, where it stands (approved at revision N, draft, retired) and when it last changed
expectations.specClaim: Each row says its standing in words

expectations.desc: A spec whose head revision is newer than the approved one says revision M is waiting for approval
expectations.specClaim: Rows say when a revision waits for approval

expectations.desc: An empty list says how specs get made and shows no counts
expectations.specClaim: A workspace with no specs says how specs get made

expectations.desc: Renders with no error text or broken layout

routes.title: Spec page

expectations.desc: One line names the revision being read and, when newer, that a revision waits for approval
expectations.specClaim: The page names the revision being read

expectations.desc: Revisions are listed newest first with who wrote and who approved each
expectations.specClaim: The page lists every revision, newest first

expectations.desc: The spec body renders as Markdown after related specs and history
expectations.specClaim: The body comes after related specs and revision history

expectations.desc: A revision waiting for approval can be approved from the same page by someone allowed to
Renders with no error text or horizontal overflow

routes.paramHint: Use any existing spec ID (QA_SPEC_ID / spec_id). Skip if no specs exist.

expectations.desc: A message composer is present and usable at the viewport width
Earlier chats are listed or reachable, or a plain empty state invites a first message
A turn renders in fixed regions: no duplicated text or overlapping cards
expectations.specClaim: Streaming text, tools and loading cards never move or duplicate

expectations.desc: Renders with no error text or horizontal overflow
Settings sections are listed by plain names, and open as a full page on a phone
expectations.specClaim: List then detail on a phone

expectations.desc: Team lives under Settings, not as a primary destination
Labels are sentence case plain words, not internal vocabulary
Renders with no error text or broken layout

verdictVocabulary.MATCHES-SPEC: Element/behaviour is present and matches the spec claim
verdictVocabulary.CONTRADICTED: Element is built but behaves contrary to the spec claim
verdictVocabulary.DOCUMENTED-NOT-BUILT: Spec claims this should exist but it is absent from the rendered UI
verdictVocabulary.SHIPPED-NOT-DOCUMENTED: UI shows something not mentioned in spec — flag for spec backfill

vercelPreviewBypass.notes: Set this header on every request to bypass Vercel preview protection

appAuth.notes: Pre-authenticated Playwright storage state (JSON) containing the session cookie. Generate once with the setup script, store as encrypted secret.
